text:
The data detected **0.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021**, in patches smaller than the tool’s 0.5-hectare minimum event size. No qualifying loss events were reported from 2021 through 2025.

The JRC reference mapped no forest on the property in 2020, so the detected loss is not corroborated by that reference. Earlier losses, including 67.7 hectares in 2020, occurred before the period in question.
